note: Difficulty (1 easiest - 5 hardest) and time are this guide's own estimates from the official descriptions, not PlayStation's numbers. Tips are our own words; counts and grades come from the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles. An 'avoid' line appears only on missable trophies: exactly how to keep from missing that one.

notes.tip: The platinum is pure bookkeeping: it pops when the other 54 are done. Keep this checklist ticked as you go, and the last trophy you earn decides when it pops - usually A Long Road or the final collectible.

notes.avoid: Finish Gone Fishing in one go - quitting mid-mission means replaying the opening.
notes.tip: Just play the opening mission through to its end screen. It fires on completion, so do not quit mid-mission.

notes.avoid: Complete every Chapter 1 mission in order - the trophy is earned once, at the chapter's close.
notes.tip: Push the story markers through Chapter 1; the trophy lands on the chapter's final mission. No side content is needed.

notes.avoid: Complete every Chapter 2 mission in order - the trophy is earned once, at the chapter's close.
notes.tip: Same pattern as Chapter 1: follow the story markers and finish the chapter's last mission.

notes.avoid: Complete every Chapter 3 mission in order - the trophy is earned once, at the chapter's close.
notes.tip: Finish Chapter 3's missions in story order, and use the run to pick up the mission trophies that share these chapters.

notes.avoid: Complete every Chapter 4 mission in order, and clear the other story missables before the finale.
notes.tip: The last numbered chapter. Before its final mission, check the Missables page - the story-only missables should already be ticked.

notes.avoid: Do not start the final mission until every earlier story-mission trophy is earned - afterwards the only way back is a replay.
notes.tip: The finale unlocks after Chapter 4. Clear every other story-mission trophy first: the finale is the point of no return.

notes.avoid: Take the mission when offered and finish it - a named mission earns its trophy once, on completion.
notes.tip: Take Breakfast Run when it appears in your mission list and play it to the end.

notes.avoid: Complete the setup chain and the heist in one story run; the trophy fires once, on the heist's completion.
notes.tip: Finish the heist setups the game offers first, then play the heist itself. Only the named heist mission counts - no free-roam robbery does.

notes.avoid: Take the mission when offered and finish it - a named mission earns its trophy once, on completion.
notes.tip: Take Child's Play when it unlocks and finish it. The exact trigger is not pinned down by the official description, so follow the story markers.

notes.avoid: Take the mission when offered and finish it - a named mission earns its trophy once, on completion.
notes.tip: Start Headliners from its story marker when it appears and play it to the end.

notes.avoid: Take the mission when offered and finish it - a named mission earns its trophy once, on completion.
notes.tip: Finish the mission's objectives in order at Vice City International Airport. This is the named mission only - the free-roam airport trophy is separate.

notes.avoid: Take the mission when offered and finish it - a named mission earns its trophy once, on completion.
notes.tip: Take the mission when the story offers it and play it through with the gear the mission hands you.
The last big trophy before the platinum. Use the in-game stats page as your 100% checklist and work this guide's stages in order - story, strangers, activities, collectibles, money.
Take jumps and near-misses whenever you drive, instead of grinding them at the end. Check the in-game stats count before the endgame so you are not chasing 200 stunts after the story.
Try one of each activity type early: a race, fishing, the arcade, the shooting range, a drone race. One try each is enough - you do not need to win.
The hardest activity trophy. Work the range's challenge list one weapon at a time and replay any silver until it turns gold. Learn the scoring first, then chase golds.
Learn each course on a practice run, then race to win. A win at each location is what counts - the official description does not list how many locations there are, so check the in-game race menu.
Twenty different events, not the same race twenty times. Work through the race list across Leonida and pick the faster car for each course.
Steady reeling beats frantic mashing when a catch fights. Losing just means retrying - this one is not missable.
Play any arcade game through to its end screen. Do it early: it pairs with the try-every-activity trophy.

notes.avoid: Play Andy's strand to its final mission before the endgame - a strand left half-done stalls the Strangers & Freaks silver.
notes.tip: Take Andy's missions whenever his marker appears and follow the strand to its final mission.

notes.avoid: Play Kenton's strand to its final mission before the endgame - a strand left half-done stalls the Strangers & Freaks silver.
notes.tip: Kenton's missions appear as the story moves on - pick them up when offered and play the strand through.

notes.avoid: Play Billy's strand to its final mission before the endgame - a strand left half-done stalls the Strangers & Freaks silver.
notes.tip: Billy's strand is one of the eight the Strangers & Freaks trophy counts, so keep his missions moving whenever his marker shows.
Eight strands: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone are five of them, so find three more strangers with markers around the state. Track all eight here.

notes.avoid: Play Randy's strand to its final mission before the endgame - a strand left half-done stalls the Strangers & Freaks silver.
notes.tip: Take Randy's missions as they appear and play the strand to its end.

notes.avoid: Play Tyrone's strand to its final mission before the endgame - a strand left half-done stalls the Strangers & Freaks silver.
notes.tip: Follow Tyrone's marker whenever it appears and play the strand through to its last mission.
Sweep the meditation spots region by region and tick each one off. The official description gives no count, so use the in-game map markers - the far corners are the spots players miss.
Follow Bret's directions to the unique animal - one named target, not any animal of the species. The description does not name the animal or the ground, so take Bret's hunt when it is offered.
Cards are hidden around Leonida - sweep one region at a time and check your collection to see which sets are close. A set counts only when every card in it is found.
Pair it with the full-exploration trophy and the vehicle-discovery count: one long road trip across the state moves all three at once.
Pick the easy challenges first - driving, shooting, exploration - and let the count build. Fifty is a fraction of the full list, so this pops well before 100%.

notes.avoid: Do it with your partner beside you in one run - the trophy needs the partner present at the exact moment the heat clears.
notes.tip: Your partner must be beside you when the stars clear. Build the 4-star heat in open country, break line of sight, switch cars, and hide until the wanted level drops.

notes.avoid: Rob three shops back-to-back in a single run without losing the wanted level - if the heat drops between shops, the streak resets and you start over.
notes.tip: Plan a route past three close shops and hit them fast. The streak breaks if the wanted level drops between robberies, so keep moving and do not linger.
Drive everything you pass - cars, bikes, boats, trucks - rather than sticking to one favourite. The count climbs fastest during free-roam exploration.
Lure a group together first, then trigger Combat Focus at close range and chain the takedowns before it ends. A crowded firefight is the place to try it - one or two enemies will not reach five.

notes.avoid: Take off from VCIA by air in free roam. It is a one-off moment, not a mission - do it while you are passing the airport, not after the story.
notes.tip: Grab a plane on the ground at VCIA and take off - leave by air without a scheduled flight. Expect heat the moment you move, so get airborne fast.
Look for a Rhino at a military base or during a mission that hands you one. The official description names no exact spot, so take the first Rhino you can reach.
Go in quiet and move fast - no alarms, no witnesses raising the alarm. If you are spotted, leave, let the heat die, and try again.
Five vaults, five escapes - the count is escapes, not attempts. Plan the getaway before the robbery, with a fast car parked close by.
Hit the truck somewhere with easy escape routes, not downtown, and have a getaway car ready before you start.
Drive every road and visit every region; the in-game map shows what is still blank. Sweep the far edges last, when you have a fast car.
One illegal operation per gang, not several from the same crew. The description does not name the gangs or their spots, so use the in-game map and gang markers.

notes.avoid: Visit Ocean Beach and take the cocktail with the view in free roam - it is a quiet one-off moment, so do it while exploring rather than after the story.
notes.tip: Walk the Ocean Beach front until the prompt appears - the description names the beach but no exact bar, so take the cocktail where the sea is in view.

notes.avoid: Smash out of a showroom in free roam while exploring. The description names no specific showroom, so use any you find - do not leave it for the endgame.
notes.tip: Any vehicle showroom works - build speed and drive a car straight through the front glass in one run.

notes.avoid: Bowl a full game at the Kolt & Associates alley. It is the one named location - another bowling alley does not count.
notes.tip: The Kolt & Associates bowling alley specifically - bowl a full game there. Any other lane does not count.
Play the partner content and keep the partnership active. The description is deliberately vague, so check the in-game partner stats to see what is being counted.

notes.avoid: Make the story choices when the game asks. This fires on a decision that may not come back - do not rush past choice moments.
notes.tip: It comes with the story - take a decision when the game asks you to choose. Which choice it is, the official description does not say, so do not chase it.

notes.avoid: When an event fails, retry it straight away and succeed on the second attempt - the trophy is tied to that second go.
notes.tip: A retry moment: fail or repeat an event once, then succeed on the second go. The description does not say which event, so treat it as one that pops in normal play.

notes.avoid: Trigger the odd event in free roam while exploring. Rushing the story past strange prompts is how players miss it.
notes.tip: An odd event or easter egg the description will not spoil. Explore, follow odd prompts, and it will find you - do not grind for it.
Melee weapon, moving vehicle, crowded street: build speed, line up a group on foot, and swing as you pass. A gun does not count - pick a bat or similar.
Marked Bills come from robberies and heists - hand them to your contacts to clean them. The total is cumulative, so small jobs add up toward $250,000.
Cumulative across every shop - weapons, clothes, cars, anything. Buy what you actually use and let it build; a big purchase closes the gap at the endgame.
Save up and buy garages as they appear on the property market. Check the listings for which are still unbought - keep a cash reserve, the last one is usually the priciest.
Register ten different vehicles in the Scooter Bros app - the ones you drive anyway. The app is named in the description: use it, not a garage.
